description: Single full-body native pixel-art game sprite. IDENTITY MUST MATCH: Tall solid muscular mature man. SILVER-WHITE hair swept back into a visible low PONYTAIL behind neck. Black aviator sunglasses. Rugged angular face with several long parallel diagonal old scars across cheek, light chin stubble and confident smirk. Black suit jacket AND white shirt sleeves ROLLED UP TO BOTH ELBOWS; strong bare forearms and hands covered with many branching old scars. White shirt and black tie. Ponytail, cheek scars, rolled sleeves and forearm scars are essential. Black trousers and plain black formal shoes. Relaxed upright stance with empty hands at sides. Front-facing SOUTH, low top-down camera. Natural adult anatomy, about 7 heads tall, normal torso and pelvis. Anatomical crown-to-sole height 230-236 pixels on a 128x256 canvas; hair may extend above crown. Soles at y248; leave unused space ABOVE shorter people, do NOT enlarge to fill frame. Keep individual build and facial features. Match reference ONLY for crisp 1px pixel clusters, selective dark outlines and controlled shading. Keep own hair and costume colors. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no held weapons. Whole hair and shoes within frame.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY pixel rendering, outline, shading and lighting. Do not copy the reference male height, body shape, shoulder width, outfit or identity. Preserve this character own stature, build, age, hair, irises and original clothing colors and silhouette. FRONT view.
